mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, mkey AS memoryKey, value, source, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY confidence DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory (user_id, kind, mkey, value, source, confidence) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{memoryKey}, #{value}, #{source}, #{confidence}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), source = VALUES(source), confidence = VALUES(confidence), deleted_at = NULL, expires_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_memory SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
